style: Vertical 9:16 frame. Stop-motion nature film still: ultra-detailed macro photograph of a handcrafted miniature set, monarch butterfly life cycle. Shallow depth of field, creamy green bokeh background, soft warm natural sunlight from the upper left, fresh saturated greens, cinematic. Subject centered in the middle third of the frame with empty space at the bottom for captions. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
consistency: Keep EXACTLY the same camera angle, framing, lighting, background, leaf/branch and subject design as the reference image. Change only what is described.

scenes.caption: Telur rama-rama muncul di atas daun.
scenes.base: Top-down macro shot of a single large fresh green milkweed leaf filling the frame, with dew drops. Small pale cream ribbed monarch butterfly eggs sit on the leaf surface.
poses: Only one tiny ribbed egg on the leaf, near the center-left.
Two ribbed eggs on the leaf.
Three ribbed eggs on the leaf.
Four ribbed eggs in a loose row across the leaf, glistening.

scenes.caption: Telur menetas dan ulat kecil keluar.
scenes.base: Macro close-up, side view, of one large translucent cream ribbed monarch egg on a green leaf.
poses: The egg is intact with a tiny crack appearing at its top.
The top of the egg is broken open and a tiny pale caterpillar head with a black face peeks out.
The tiny pale translucent caterpillar is halfway out of the broken eggshell.
The tiny pale caterpillar has fully crawled out next to the empty broken eggshell.

scenes.caption: Ulat kecil mula makan daun.
scenes.base: Macro side view of a small pale yellow-green hairy caterpillar with a black head on the edge of a bright green leaf.
poses: The caterpillar is at the leaf edge; the leaf is whole.
The caterpillar is chewing; one small round hole is eaten in the leaf.
Two round holes in the leaf and a small bite in the leaf edge.
Three round holes and a bigger chewed notch in the leaf edge; caterpillar slightly larger.

scenes.caption: Ulat membesar dan semakin matang.
scenes.base: Macro side view of a monarch caterpillar on a large green leaf.
poses: The caterpillar is still small and pale, with faint stripes beginning to show.
The caterpillar is medium sized with clear yellow, black and white stripes.
The caterpillar is large and plump with bold yellow, black and white stripes and black tentacles.
The caterpillar is fully grown, big, plump, bold yellow-black-white stripes, crawling forward.

scenes.caption: Ulat menggantung pada ranting.
scenes.base: Side view of a brown twig crossing the top of the frame against a soft green bokeh background. A fully grown striped monarch caterpillar is attached to the underside of the twig by a small silk pad.
poses: The caterpillar is still crawling along the underside of the twig.
The caterpillar's tail is attached to the silk pad and its body starts to hang down.
The caterpillar hangs straight down from the twig.
The caterpillar hangs from the twig curled into a J shape.

scenes.caption: Ulat berubah menjadi kepompong.
scenes.base: Side view of the same brown twig across the top of the frame, soft green bokeh background. Something hangs from the twig.
poses: A striped caterpillar hangs in a J shape, its skin starting to split and turning greenish.
Half-transformed: top half is jade green chrysalis, bottom half still shows shriveling striped skin.
A nearly complete jade green chrysalis with a small crumpled black skin falling off the bottom.
A perfect smooth jade green monarch chrysalis with a thin golden dotted band, hanging from the twig.

scenes.caption: Kepompong berubah dan corak sayap mula kelihatan.
scenes.base: Side view of a monarch chrysalis hanging from the same brown twig, soft green-golden bokeh background.
poses: The chrysalis is jade green with a golden band, starting to darken slightly.
The chrysalis is becoming translucent; faint dark shapes visible inside.
The chrysalis is mostly transparent; orange and black wing pattern clearly visible inside.
The chrysalis is fully transparent and dark; vivid folded orange-black monarch wings visible inside.

scenes.caption: Rama-rama keluar dari kepompong.
scenes.base: Side view of the same brown twig with a transparent monarch chrysalis hanging from it, warm golden bokeh background.
poses: The bottom of the transparent chrysalis splits open and black legs poke out.
A monarch butterfly head and legs emerge from the split chrysalis.
The monarch butterfly is half out, crumpled small wings hanging.
The monarch butterfly hangs below the empty clear chrysalis shell, wings still small, crumpled and folded.

scenes.caption: Sayap mengembang sehingga terbuka sepenuhnya.
scenes.base: Side view of a monarch butterfly hanging from the same brown twig next to its empty clear chrysalis shell, warm golden bokeh background.
poses: The wings are small, crumpled and folded down.
The wings are expanding, about half their full size, still slightly wrinkled.
The wings are nearly full size, flat, bright orange with black veins and white dots, closed together.
The wings are fully expanded and spread open wide, bright orange with black veins and white-dotted borders.

scenes.caption: Rama-rama dewasa terbang dan hinggap di bunga.
scenes.base: Hero shot of a beautiful adult monarch butterfly and a vivid pink zinnia flower with a yellow center in a sunlit garden, golden hour glow, soft bokeh.
poses: The butterfly flies above the flower with wings spread upward.
The butterfly flies closer to the flower with wings spread flat.
The butterfly is landing on the flower with wings half raised.
The butterfly rests on the pink zinnia with wings fully open, glowing in the sunlight.
